CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.default_admin_permissions(p_role text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' then '{"can_approve_requests": true, "can_review_violations": true, "can_view_logs": true, "can_export_csv": true, "can_manage_limits": true, "can_view_audit": true}'::jsonb
    else '{"can_approve_requests": true, "can_review_violations": true, "can_view_logs": true, "can_export_csv": false, "can_manage_limits": false, "can_view_audit": false}'::jsonb
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_approved_employee_identity_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN

IF OLD.status = 'APPROVED' THEN

    IF NEW.full_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.full_name
    OR NEW.employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.employee_id
    OR NEW.mobile_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mobile_number
    OR NEW.specialty IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.specialty
    OR NEW.department IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.department
    OR NEW.job_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.job_type
    OR NEW.employee_photo_url IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.employee_photo_url
    THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION 
        'Approved employee identity fields cannot be modified directly';

    END IF;

END IF;

RETURN NEW;

END;
$function$
